g.text: What it shows: how each share moved between 2026-04 and 2026-05 — the only comparison this release supports, since it

g.text: publishes two months. The 12 largest movements are shown.

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Anthropic's published Economic Index data documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Two consecutive months is not a trend and nothing here is extrapolated. The largest movement is a 2.2-point fall in the work share

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: against a rise in personal use, which one month apart is as likely to be seasonal or a classifier revision as a change in behaviour.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Percentage-point metrics only: the means in years, hours and index points do not share this axis. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and

g.text: Max consumer plans plus Cowork; Anthropic's API traffic is a separate file and is not included here.
